title: Zesty Roasted Korean Beef Ssam
description: A tender and flavorful Korean dish featuring roasted beef, served in a dolsot stone bowl with meringue nests and lamination puff, perfect for a diabetic-friendly date night dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger to make the marinade.
Add the beef short ribs to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the beef from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the beef in the preheated oven for 2 hours, or until tender and caramelized.
While the beef is roasting, prepare the meringue nests according to package instructions.
Toast the sesame seeds in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes, or until fragrant.
To assemble the ssam, place a portion of the roasted beef in a dolsot stone bowl, top with a meringue nest, a piece of lamination puff, green onions, and toasted sesame seeds.
Drizzle the sesame oil over the top and serve immediately.
